summary.text: Trey Caldwell is a Republican member of the Oklahoma House of Representatives who has represented District 63 since 2018 and is seeking re-election in the November 3, 2026 general election.

paragraphs.text: Trey Caldwell, whom Ballotpedia lists as Hurchel Caldwell, is an Oklahoma native who graduated from MacArthur High School in 2008 and earned a bachelor's degree in finance in 2013.
Ballotpedia describes his profession as financial adviser with Merrill Lynch.
He took office on November 21, 2018, succeeding Jeff Coody.
Ballotpedia lists his 2025-2026 committee assignments as chair of the Appropriations and Budget Committee and a member of the Energy and Natural Resources Oversight Committee.
Shykira Smith, a Democrat, is his opponent in the November 3, 2026 general election.
